image_description: A blue plastic barrel positioned outdoors against a red wooden wall. A black downspout elbow is inserted into the top of the barrel through a makeshift opening that appears damaged or crudely cut, with jagged edges and debris visible around the rim. The barrel has horizontal ridges typical of industrial drums and a white label on the side. There is no visible spigot near the base.
